mentions.name: PubDB
mentions.description: A revived 10-year-old project that makes research publications more accessible to ordinary readers using AI, currently building an OCR indexing pipeline and generating AI summaries.
mentions.problem: Research publications are hard for non-experts ("mere mortals") to access and understand.
mentions.audience: General readers ("mere mortals") who want to understand research publications
mentions.source_excerpt: https://pubdb.com/ - Reviving a 10 year old project, it’s meant to make research publications more accessible to mere mortals with the help of AI. I have lots of ideas I want to try out here but haven’t gotten around to it yet. Currently focused on nailing down the basics with an OCR indexing pipeline and generating AI summaries.
